compatibility.synthetic: final-stage cached paths of each world; path j hedges validation contract j mod 1388
compatibility.loss: payoff - hedge gains + 0.05% perp costs, % of S0 (no premium, option fee or funding)
compatibility.gap: rho_synthetic - rho_real, rho in {CVaR95, std of loss}
compatibility.predictor: |gap|; primary = own policy |gap CVaR95|; realism primary = W1 standardised
compatibility.statistic: Spearman rank correlation, one-sided exact permutation p-value, n = 4 per family and 8 pooled

ww_band.rule: lowest CVaR95 loss on the 2021 validation options (1x fees)

mv_delta.fit: Hull-White OLS (no intercept) on 2021 daily changes of Deribit mark prices (last trade per instrument in 07:00-08:00 UTC, consecutive days)

smile_delta.variant: smile-implied (scale-invariant = sticky-moneyness) delta: delta_BS - phi(d1) sqrt(tau) theta
smile_delta.theta: OLS quadratic of median trade IV on log(K/S) over same-expiry strikes traded 07:00-08:00 UTC on the entry day; slope at the option's moneyness
